fields.place: Govinda-kuṇḍa (Govardhana): a hut north of Śrīnāthajī's temple
fields.notes: A simple Oṛiyā gopa who did bhajana at Govinda-kuṇḍa, by Śrīnāthajī's temple; five hours of kīrtana before Giridhārī every morning, worship of Tulasī, mādhukarī shared with all the Vaiṣṇavas. Sang the glories of Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa and Vṛndā in Oṛiyā; had darśana of Vṛndā-devī. Advaita dāsa Bābājī (#17) looked after him and gave him Tulasī-water at his death. (The guru field said «Śrī Advaita Bābājī», but the text only shows Advaita dāsa with him; his guru is not named.)

fields.disappearance: Śarat-pūrṇimā (the full moon of Āśvina), at Nūtana-gherā near Rādhā-kuṇḍa (the record's text)
fields.notes: A bābājī of Vraja who did everything at a run so as to lose no time from bhajana; ate nothing at night. In old age at Nūtana-gherā near Rādhā-kuṇḍa, on prasāda from Rājarṣi Vanamālī Rāya's temple of Rādhā-vinoda. Advised Kāminī Kumār Ghoṣ against drowsiness in bhajana. Found passed away sitting on his āsana on Śarat-pūrṇimā. Not the Hare Kṛṣṇa dāsa of the Abhidhāna (a translator of the Rāsa-pañcādhyāya).

fields.place: Vṛndāvana (head of the ṭhaurā of Siddha Ṭoṭārāma dāsa Bābājī); Rādhā-kuṇḍa (Śyāma-kuṇḍa)
fields.notes: A great scholar, renounced and sparing of words; head of the ṭhaurā of Siddha Ṭoṭārāma dāsa Bābājī in Vṛndāvana (perhaps Ṭoṭā Rāmadāsa #1553, who had lived at a ṭhaurā south of the Gopīnātha temple). With 5,000 rupees from Rājarṣi Vanamālī Rāya and years of begging, he had Śyāma-kuṇḍa cleaned and restored, never spending a paisa of the fund on himself; Kāminī Bābu ran the work. (The guru field said «Siddha Ṭoṭārāma»; the text only says he headed his ṭhaurā.)
